units.source_text: 他吩咐家臣：元旦招待贺客，应比往年更加隆重。

en.t: He instructed his retainers that the New Year's Day reception for congratulatory guests should be even more splendid than in previous years.

units.source_text: 赠送诸亲王及大臣的礼品，以及赏赐各种人等的福物，均须尽量从丰。

en.t: The gifts presented to the princes and ministers, as well as the lucky offerings bestowed on people of every rank, were all to be made as generous as possible.
